grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description:
Needs a free hand and a move into close-quarters combat.
On a success the opponent has {skills} to Combat/Physical/Esoterics and can only Block or Attack, if the hold allows it.

pin.name: Pin
pin.description:
Follows a Grapple, a short action in the same round.
Compares STR x {mult} against STR x {mult} (-5 to -25 for size, weight and armor, at the GM's discretion).
The opponent has {skills} to combat. Melee attacks against them get {melee}, missile attacks {missile}.

push.name: Push
push.description:
Pushes the opponent back and temporarily breaks off the fight. Succeeds automatically against smaller or weaker opponents.
Compare STR tests: the opponent is pushed back 5 ft and the fight is temporarily disengaged.
Can be combined with Rapid Attack.
CS: also a Stumble test (the opponent may go Prone).
Automatic Push: a short action against smaller or weaker opponents.

ram.name: Ram
ram.description:
Only when entering a fight; needs a run-up of at least 15 ft. A short action (you can attack afterwards).
With a shield the other side gets -10; on a success the defender is knocked down.

trip.name: Trip
trip.description: An attack with a suitable weapon (polearm, falcastrum, axe, hammer ...) at -10 high/low.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Entangling the opponent with a net, a cloak or something similar.

feint.name: Feint
feint.description:
An attack with a penalty by weapon. On a success the defender's defense is halved; on a critical success the defender cannot defend.
Penalty by weapon: Estoc -5, Sabre/Sword -10, Longsword/Zweihander -15, Spear -20, others -30.
CS = no defense | S = defense halved.

rapidAttack.name: Rapid attack
rapidAttack.description: Two strikes with one weapon, each at -10. Adds +2 Fatigue.

rapidFire.name: Rapid fire
rapidFire.description: Rapid shooting with a bow. Each shot has -20. Not possible with a crossbow.

twoWeaponCombat.name: Two-weapon combat
twoWeaponCombat.description: Attacking with both hands. The off hand has -20 to attack. Defending with two weapons gives +10.

defensiveStance.name: Defensive stance
defensiveStance.description:
A defensive stance lets you take a penalty of -10 to -25 on an attack; the same amount is added to your next defense.
It stacks with a shield and two weapons and cannot be used for offensive kinds of defense.

aimedAttack.name: Aimed attack
aimedAttack.description: Allows attacking a specific location at -15.

aimedFire.name: Aimed fire
aimedFire.description: Spending one round aiming gives the character +20 on the next shot.

catchBreath.name: Catch breath
catchBreath.description:
Taking no action on your turn lowers Fatigue by 2; taking no actions at all during the round lowers it by 3.
No action on your turn: Fatigue -2

cover.name: Cover
cover.description:
Cover against missile fire: -10 to -30 for the shooter (full cover = cannot shoot).
Shooting past a character = -20.
